files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Fixed
- **The web interface hung and timed out on multi-user instances** (Fix [#202](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/issues/202), PR [#203](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/pull/203)). `FileDuplicateMapper::findAll()` and `getTotalCount()` ignored the `$user` and `$type` parameters in SQL, so every call to `/api/duplicates/...` walked the global `duplicatefinder_dups` table and resolved every file node of every group in PHP before discarding the groups that did not belong to the current user (or that only had a single copy for that user, such as cross-user duplicates or shared single files). Groups are now filtered by user and acknowledgement status directly in SQL (requiring at least two non-ignored copies in the user's tree), `FileInfoService::enrich()` skips redundant filesystem node lookups when a `FileInfo` has already been enriched, and `App.vue` no longer triggers a second concurrent `/api/duplicates/all` fetch on mount. Checked on Nextcloud 28 and 34 with multiple users and shared folders: a user with no duplicate now gets an empty response in milliseconds instead of scanning every group in the database

### Changed
- **`occ duplicates:list-all` now leaves out shared views by default** (Fix [#197](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/issues/197), PR [#204](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/pull/204)). A file seen through a share is indexed with the path of the recipient (`/bob/files/...`) and the `owner` of the sharer (`alice`), so counting that row overstated the number of copies and the wasted space, and listed single shared files as duplicates. Rows whose path is not in their owner's tree are now excluded by default, and groups that have only one copy left are omitted. Pass `--include-shared` to include shared views in the report
